I_class.proposition: Under the supplied exclusive task annotation policy, this audio query belongs to the supplied intent category.
I_class.paraphrase: Applying the same supplied exclusive annotation policy, is the supplied intent category the category assigned to this audio query?
I_class.constraint: Do not replace exclusive category membership with absence of every other possible intention.

I_present.proposition: This audio query expresses a user intention satisfying the supplied intent definition.
I_present.paraphrase: Does this audio query express a user intention that meets the supplied intent definition?
I_present.constraint: A topic mention or explicitly rejected action alone does not establish an intention; use the supplied scope policy.

S_present.proposition: This audio query expresses a semantic role satisfying the supplied type definition and its stated presence policy.
S_present.paraphrase: Under its stated presence policy, is a semantic role meeting the supplied type definition expressed in this audio query?
S_present.constraint: Keep the entire supplied definition, mention scope, presence policy, and coexistence rules unchanged. Presence is not applicability or binding.

B_bound.proposition: There exists an intention instance expressed in this audio query that satisfies the supplied intent definition and has a semantic role of the supplied type bound to that instance.
B_bound.paraphrase: Is at least one expressed instance of the supplied intent associated by semantic binding with a role satisfying the supplied type definition?
B_bound.constraint: Mere co-occurrence is insufficient. Negation means no such bound instance exists, not that some unbound instance exists.

admission: Input truth must be independently admitted for model scoring; transformation never upgrades reference-only or disputed evidence.
input_isolation: Q template depends only on operator and configured variant; no gold, reference transcript or review rationale in actor input.
paired_calls: Each variant is a separate one-forward request; never feed one answer to another or concatenate paired outcomes as reasoning.
definitions: All semantic cards, presence policies and shared boundary rules remain verbatim; operator paraphrase is not a definition-card paraphrase test.
coverage: Pair scoring requires reliable base truth and both scheduled requests; invalid output counts wrong, incomplete jobs remain partial.
interpretation: Question-polarity sensitivity and operator-wording robustness only; not sufficient evidence of audio grounding, new-concept understanding or multi-step causal reasoning.
anti_shortcut: Always answering true on affirmative and false on complement perfectly satisfies opposite consistency but fails all base-negative both-correct cases; require polarity-stratified both-correct and audio grounding controls.
dataset_transfer: Same operator templates can be reused only with independently valid dataset definitions and truth policies.
evaluation_budget: Separate atomic diagnostic at Stage1 and preregistered terminal checkpoint; full admitted population and definitions selected before model outputs; exact expansion counts and context checks required before dispatch.
